name: check_room
description: Checks whether a study room is available for a requested time slot. This tool only checks availability and does not save or create a booking. All time values (start, end, now, and existing bookings) must be whole integer minutes since midnight in the range 0 to 1440.

start.description: Requested booking start time in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440).

end.description: Requested booking end time in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440).

now.description: Current time in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440).

blocked.description: Whether the room is currently blocked by an administrator (true or false).

bookings.description: List of existing bookings for the room, each with start and end in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440). May be empty.

start.description: Existing booking start time in whole minutes since midnight.

end.description: Existing booking end time in whole minutes since midnight.
